finding.text: `AIDashboard.open_day()` calls itself as its last line (diff.patch line 87, where `this.store.open(this.q.day)` used to be), so `/framework/ai/`, the default AI dashboard, recurses until the stack overflows and never loads its day. Change that line back to `this.store.open(this.q.day)`.

The scope change says "nothing on the AI dashboard", but the diff still changes it: `AIDashboard.js` gets a Review head, Approve buttons and a Ready to merge band, and `AIDashboard.css`, `SessionRow.js` and `SessionStore.js` change too. Revert those files, or keep only the shared `Review`/`Approvals` classes (the readme already plans to move them beside `v/review`).

The rows repeat themselves. Line 1 says "mastermind · 16 h ago", then line 2 says "waiting for you · mastermind, no parent recorded". The role appears twice, and "no parent recorded" is noise for the owner (content). shots/…-v-review/1920.png, list band.

There is no page that shows the live instances of the new classes `Review`, `Approvals`, `FilterPill`, `TimeFilter` and `ReviewList` (rules.md, "Show the class"). `Review` holds the day's approved/waiting/leaking state, which the owner would want to watch.

At 1920 and 3440 the head card (three totals and Approve all) sits in a narrow left column, and the empty space under it runs the full height. layout.json reports empty 0.58 at 1920 and 0.72 at 3440. At 1920 the list rows are about 950 px wide with short text and the Approve button far right. Two columns of rows, or a head band across the top, would use the width.
On the v/ index (touched by the diff) at 400, the `sessions-chip` buttons wrap to 4 lines each (layout.json wraps, lines 4). This is probably not new in this diff.

Ask 1 says "find the true parent link and fix the generator, don't patch around it", but the diff touches no generator (nothing under `Server/`, `session-tree.json` unchanged). Instead `SessionWork.js:267-268` prints "33 tasks ran in sessions filed under another day: their cost and Approve are not shown here yet", which is the patch-around the owner ruled out. shots/work-1920.png shows the result: the "deputy" and "Figma: mobile cards" rows have no Approve button and show $0.00, and those 33 tasks' cost is missing from the rolled-up total.

The diff leaves loose references to `v/review`, a page this diff does not add and that is not on michael/dev. `ux/Filter/readme.md:576` names it as "First user", which is a dead link. `css-scopes.txt:418` registers `rv-` for it. `MobileRow.js`/`MobileHome.js` gain `Row`, `dot_key`, `href`, `below` and `after` seams "for v/review's ReviewRow", and nothing uses them. Point the readme at the Work tab (`AISession/SessionWork.js`) and drop `rv-`. The seams are fine to keep, but their comments should not name a page that does not exist.

`Review.js` repeats itself (law 6). Its `walk()`, `totals()` and `ready()` are never called, because `SessionWork.judge()` (`SessionWork.js:243-249`) and `paint()` (`:256`) re-implement the same approved/live/leak/waiting rule and the same totals with slightly different inputs (`n.state` vs `DONE`, `n.last` vs `f.last`). Keep one: either SessionWork calls `Review`, or `Review` shrinks to its constants and `STATES`.

Ask 3 names `Session.progress()` as "the one counting code". `SessionWork.js:239` calls `Task.progress_of` directly. That gives the same count (Session.progress wraps it), but the open-task list (`:238`) treats `stopped` as done while the progress count does not. So "0 of 4 complete" and the "Open:" list can disagree about the same task.

`paint()` calls `TimeFilter.add({ root: this.$list })` (`SessionWork.js:260`) on every repaint, and every approval event triggers a repaint. Each call adds another `MutationObserver` on the same list, and the old ones are never disconnected. The newest pill happens to win because observers fire in the order they were added, but the observers keep piling up. Build the pill once in `render()` and only call `apply()` on repaint.

The README update promised in the last `show:` line ("The AISession readme needs a Work tab line (SessionWork, Approvals, Review)") is not in the diff. Ask 4 also wants each class documented where it lives.

shots/work-1920.png and work-400.png: a folded row (`details.sw-node`) is drawn as a grey bordered card, while a plain row is flat, so the nested list looks like a mix of cards and rows. The builder noticed this too. The mobile picks ask for flat rows with one indent.

The head's Approve all writes only the session's own line (`SessionWork.js:266`), and children are approved because the state is inherited when read. That is what the brief asked for. But "Approve all" here means the same thing as the head's own Approve, so a single button labelled "Approve this session and everything in it" would be simpler.

None of the new classes (`SessionWork`, `Approvals`, `Review`, `FilterPill`, `TimeFilter`) has a page that lists its live instances (rules.md, "Show the class"). `Approvals` holds the state the owner would watch.
A row still shows a folder slug as its title: the first child reads "deputy" (requirements 2, "plain title") — shots/work-flat-400.png, first row; shots/work-1920.png, first row.

The parent link was patched around, not fixed at its source (requirements 1, "fix the generator, don't patch around it"). The diff never touches the `session-tree.json` generator. SessionWork nests by folder instead, and the head still says "10 tasks ran in sessions filed under another day: their cost and Approve are not shown here yet" (33 at 1200) — shots/work-1920.png, head card.

The review run shot the wrong page. It shot `/framework/ai/AITask/` (a Doc page this diff barely changes) and not the session page's Work tab, which is the deliverable. So everything below about the Work tab is judged from the builder's own shots: work-400, work-flat-400, work-1200, work-1920 and work-flat-1920.

The AITask shot still logs one 404 at every width (layout.json `errors`, 4 of 4), and that 404 is what the new `/api/folder-names` listing was meant to remove. It is likely the dev server had not restarted onto the plugin (Server/README.md says so), but nobody confirmed it.
At 400 the session's title shows three times (the breadcrumb, the panel head, the Work card), and the six tab chips wrap to 2 rows with "Related" alone — shots/work-flat-400.png, top three bands.
A "waiting" row's dot is grey, while the waiting total is amber and mobile-cards.md asks for amber — shots/work-1920.png, the Figma row. Only `live` is coloured amber in SessionWork.css.
The brief said "log a `show:` line, and stop for the look". The `show:` line came at 20:01, but the builder went on to `ready:` at 20:12 without the look (session.jsonl lines 39, 53).

Five new classes have no page that shows their live instances: SessionWork, Approvals, Review, FilterPill and TimeFilter. Approvals holds the approvals the owner would want to watch; today the session page itself is the only place to see them.
